title: Pilot project for characterizing the eicosanoid signal transduction pathway of healthy volunteers
summary: Eicosanoids (hormone-like substances) play an important role in the body in inflammation-mediated pain and its treatment with medications. In this study, eicosanoids in the blood and urine (biological samples) of healthy individuals will be examined in the laboratory and new research methods will be tested. The study will be conducted at Bielefeld University. A total of 40 individuals are expected to participate. The study is initiated, organized, and financed by Bielefeld University.

interventions.name: Participants in age-appropriate good health, without acute inflammatory pain or infections, provide single blood, urine, and stool samples. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Adult volunteers who, in the opinion of the PIs, are in good health for their age, including those with chronic conditions that are controlled by medication. Health status is assessed in a structured interview.                                          
 • 18 years of age or older
 • Not pregnant
 • Body weight ≥ 50 kg
 • BMI 18–28 kg/m²
 • At least 1 year of abstinence from nicotine products 
 • At least 1 week of abstinence from vitamins and fish oil products 
 • Presence of documented consent
Exclusion criteria:
• Known rheumatological disease 
• Chronic diseases that, in the opinion of the PIs, are not or insufficiently controlled by medication
• Malignant tumors that have not been in permanent remission for the past 5 years
• Severe or recurrent infection in the recent past
• Test subjects who have received an experimental drug or are participants in a drug study
